$comment: THE machine-readable product registry (ADR-W-018 decision 6 / ADR-W-021; issue #661).
One roster, several consumers: the shell/ switcher renders it as DATA (shell/ may never import
a product tree), server/__tests__/isolation.test.ts cross-checks it against BOUNDARIES.json
(a product tree with no entry FAILS the suite), and server/__tests__/registry-consistency.test.ts
asserts ci.yml's classifier and the docs/22 §9 table stay in step with it.
Adding builder N+1 means editing THIS file — the guards name every other place that must follow.
labelKey is resolved by EACH consuming product's own i18n resources; url is the prod path,
devUrl is where `npm run dev` serves the same app.
NOT DEPLOYED (operator ruling, 2026-09-03): the analytic tool stays a LOCAL tool until it
has decent capability. `enabled: false` is what makes that structural rather than a thing
to remember -- every shipped builder's roster is `filter(p => p.enabled)`, so no deployed
page can render a chip pointing at /analytic-builder/ and 404. `devOnly` is the readmission
ticket: the analytic app itself widens its filter to `enabled || (DEV && devOnly)`, so the
suite bar is whole while developing. Flip enabled to true and drop devOnly on the deploy.
